_comment: Contacts shown when the app is unsure. Two lists were merged on 19 Oct 2026: the ICAR-ATARI Bengaluru KVK page (collected 15 Oct) and the directory the site owner supplied. For each centre the owner's number comes first and the other list's number follows it; a third number, if any, is kept in 'more_phones' (the page shows two). Many numbers differ between the two lists, so NOBODY HAS PHONED THEM YET. Use kvk_call_sheet.csv: call each number once, then keep only the ones that work.
